from pathlib import Path

rows={}
for chunk in re.split(r'(?m)(?=^- ID: `)',part):
 m=re.match(r'- ID: `([^`]+)`',chunk)
 if m:
  name=m[1];assert name not in rows;rows[name]=dict(re.findall(r'^  ([A-Za-z ]+): `([^\n]*)`$',chunk,re.M))

 row=rows[root+suffix];assert row['Status']=='blocked'

 assert row['Blocked by'].startswith(expected+';')

for name,row in rows.items():
 if 'Children' in row:
